payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compare the source and edited images. Can the original mug be reliably identified in the edited image by its visual features, and where is that same mug relative to the headphones?
node.criteria: Assess the mug present in the source, not whichever edited mug best satisfies the requested relation. Complete only if the same original mug is reliably identifiable in the edited image and is now to the right of the headphones. Partial if that same mug is reliably identifiable and has moved rightward toward the headphones but is not yet to their right. Absent if the same mug is reliably identifiable and shows no progress toward moving right. Unknown if identity, displacement, or relative position cannot be established from the images. A new or duplicate mug to the right does not establish progress; do not infer movement from position alone.
node.binding: Track the single blue mug visible in the source image across to the edited image using its appearance and source position; compare that same mug's position with the headphones. Do not bind to another mug in the edited image.

outcome.description: Move the mug to the right of the headphones.
